data.title: Spinosad 0.9% lotion
data.summary: III Antiparasitics · Spinosyn insecticide (from fermentation of the soil bacterium Saccharopolyspora spinosa)
data.body:
_Topicals · III Antiparasitics_

**Class:** Spinosyn insecticide (from fermentation of the soil bacterium Saccharopolyspora spinosa)

## Mechanism of action
- Activates nicotinic acetylcholine receptors in the insect nervous system → hyperexcitation, paralysis and death
- Pediculicidal and ovicidal (contains benzyl alcohol) — often one application is enough

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Head lice in patients 6 months and older (FDA)
- Scabies (approved in the USA for age 4 years and older)

## Dose & formulations
- Head lice: cover dry scalp and hair, leave 10 min, rinse; repeat after 7 days only if live lice are seen
- Scabies: apply to the whole body, leave 10 min (label) — check current label

## Adverse effects
- Redness and irritation of scalp and eyes

## Contraindications
- Infants under 6 months (benzyl alcohol — gasping syndrome)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Minimal absorption; considered acceptable.

## Viva points
- Ovicidal — nit combing not mandatory
- Benzyl alcohol content — avoid under 6 months

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.44 (spinosad, head lice); not in Khopkar. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
